### Charlie Tossell
#### CEO at Zest
**Technical Vice President**
**$185,000 - $250,000 + Performance Bonus + Equity/LTIP Options**
**Dallas, Texas**
**About Our Client**
Zest is partnering exclusively with a low voltage controls specialist that has grown 300% year on year for the last two years. They deliver controls solutions across the data center and industrial markets, and demand shows no sign of slowing.
**The Opportunity**
Growth at this pace has outstripped the operating model that got the business here. They now need a Vice President of Operations to take ownership of delivery and build the structure that supports the next stage of scale. This is a chance to shape how a fast-moving, mission-critical business runs, with real executive visibility and the freedom to build rather than inherit.
You’ll lead operations across multiple sites and complex project environments, partnering closely with the executive team to turn exceptional demand into consistent, profitable delivery.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end-to-end operations, including project delivery, field execution, commissioning and service, across a rapidly growing portfolio
* Design and scale the operating model, processes, governance and reporting needed to support continued rapid growth
* Drive project margin, productivity, schedule performance and on-time delivery on complex data center and industrial controls projects
* Build and develop the operations leadership team, hiring and coaching project managers, regional managers and field leaders as the business grows
* Partner with sales and estimating so growth is won and delivered profitably
* Work with hyperscale and industrial customers to meet their delivery standards, prequalification requirements and expectations on mission-critical sites
* Work with the safety and quality leadership to embed EHS&Q into planning, estimating and delivery
* Define KPIs and dashboards (margin, backlog, utilisation, schedule performance) and report to senior leadership
* Manage key customer relationships and lead the response on major project escalations
**About You**

...

* Credibility with field teams, customers and senior executives alike
* Hands-on and strategic, comfortable setting vision and rolling up your sleeves
* Experience with project management and operations systems, and a track record of building repeatable processes
**What’s on Offer**
* Competitive salary plus performance bonus
* Equity/LTIP options in a business with exceptional momentum
* Executive-level visibility and the chance to shape how the business operates as it scales
* A business with exceptional momentum: 300% year-on-year growth for two consecutive years
* Exposure to hyperscale data center and industrial markets
* [Benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO]
* Genuine career progression as the business scales

Seeking an experienced, detail oriented, metrics-driven, and highly analytical professional to manage all production operations and personnel at our ~20,000sf manufacturing facility. Significant experience managing a team in a custom production environment is required.
The ideal candidate will have **strong experience in custom-manufactured products** rather than assembly/line production environments, and will have strong leadership skills, excellent organizational abilities, and a passion for continuous improvement.

...

You’ll own production team management and day-to-day fulfillment and the warehouse for all elements of the business—including foam cutting, finishing, packing and shipping. You’ll ensure our high standards of production quality and on-time delivery are met, and lead us to new standards of excellence. You will also be measured on total cost of production, helping to improve the overall efficiency of our operations.

...

This role includes competitive base compensation as well as bonus and profit-sharing potential for hitting key performance metrics, including on-time delivery, error rate, and total cost of production - your earnings will grow directly with your success through profit-sharing opportunity.

...

* **Strong experience in custom manufacturing in a high-growth environment**
* Minimum 7+ years in a manufacturing management role preferred, ideally with custom-build product lineup vs. assembly production process.
* Undergraduate degree required, ideally in an engineering/production/supply-chain or related field; MBA or graduate degree in an operational field a plus.
* **Proven success leading a team in a custom-production environment.**

...

FoamOrder.com is a rapidly-growing, leading e-commerce manufacturer of custom foam products—including cushions, mattresses, organic latex bedding, and more. Headquartered in Richmond, CA, we manufacture all products in-house and ship nationwide.
